item.title: SPEI Deposits & Withdrawals — Temporary Disruption | Depósitos y Retiros SPEI — Interrupción Temporal [resolved]
item.description:
SPEI deposits and withdrawals have been fully restored following the completion of Banxico's daily operative day change. All queued transactions are being processed.
We have identified that this disruption lasted longer than expected due to a secondary database issue on our payment infrastructure. We are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
Thank you for your patience. --- Los depósitos y retiros vía SPEI han sido completamente restaurados tras la finalización del cambio de día operativo de Banxico. Las transacciones en cola están siendo procesadas.
Identificamos que la interrupción duró más de lo esperado debido a un problema secundario en la base de datos de nuestra infraestructura de pagos. Estamos tomando medidas para prevenir que se repita.
Gracias por su paciencia.

item.title: H (Humanity Protocol) [resolved]
item.description:
Resolved. The sell window and liquidation process for H (Humanity Protocol) have concluded. As previously announced, Bitso discontinued H following a confirmed security incident that affected the original H token contract in June 2026. Selling ended on August 6, 2026 at 18:00 UTC, and any remaining H balances have since been automatically converted to Digital Dollars at market price and credited to holders' accounts. Deposits, withdrawals, buying, and selling for H remain permanently disabled. This discontinuation is final: there is no migration, airdrop, or replacement token for H, and Bitso does not list or support the new HUMANITY token. If you held H and haven't seen your balance reflecting a Digital Dollars credit in your account, please contact Support.
-----------------------------

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further assistance, do not hesitate to contact our Customer Support team at https://support.bitso.com.
